task.title: Website — Add a team member to program page — Edward Kang, PhD — Alpha Chicago
task.description:
REQUEST
Add a team member to program page

NAME
Edward Kang, PhD

EMAIL
edward.kang@alpha.school

PUBLIC TITLE
Guide

BIO
Edward Kang started his career in science, earning a Ph.D. in Molecular Neuroscience from Northwestern University, but realized he was more interested in getting young people excited about science than spending his career at the lab bench. That led him to Chicago Public Schools (CPS), where he became a science teacher and National Board Certified Teacher. Later, he founded The Laboratory Collective, a nationally recognized STEAM program focused on hands-on, creative learning, and shared their work at SXSW EDU, Falling Walls Engage in Berlin, and the United Nations' International Day of Women and Girls in Science. Most recently, he has worked as a district STEAM specialist with CPS, helping schools rethink learning through project-based instruction, technology, and AI.

QUOTE
You don’t have to master it today. Just get 1% better than yesterday.
